missingSnapshotAnalysis.verdict: FAIL CLOSED on all three cases. It does NOT silently migrate nobody.

cases.case: FILE MISSING (the state of the repo right now)
cases.path: vm.readFile at :1441 has NO try/catch. Foundry's readFile cheatcode reverts when the path does not exist (and would also revert on an fs_permissions denial). The revert propagates out of _migrateStaker -> _phase6_stakerMigration -> run(), aborting the script.
cases.result: HARD REVERT. Nothing is silently skipped.
cases.atomicityNote: Critically, this revert happens during forge's LOCAL execution pass, which always runs even under --skip-simulation (--skip-simulation only skips the on-chain simulation of the ALREADY-COLLECTED transaction list). Because the whole script body executes locally before any transaction is dispatched, a missing snapshot aborts the run BEFORE a single transaction is broadcast. Phases 1-5 and 4d are therefore NOT half-applied on mainnet - the operator loses nothing but time. This is the strongest form of fail-closed available here.
cases.residualObservation: The failure surfaces LATE in the script (line 1390 of 2171, after ~50 queued transactions have been built) and the revert message is Foundry's generic fs error, not a purpose-written 'run promotion-ready:snapshot first'. There is no Phase 0 precondition that reads or even probes for the snapshot file, even though Phase 0 is the designated require-gated precondition phase and the snapshot is documented as a hard prerequisite in three separate npm annotations. Flagged for script-auditor - not judged here.

cases.case: FILE PRESENT, EMPTY user list for a staker
cases.path: script:1391 -> require(users.length > 0 || preTotal == 0, "snapshot user list is empty but V1 still holds stake")
cases.result: HARD REVERT whenever the V1 staker still holds stake (which is the live state on all three: totalStaked 2 / 146 / 13). The `|| preTotal == 0` escape only permits an empty list for an already-empty staker.

cases.case: FILE PRESENT, SHORT / partial user list
cases.path: migrate(users) runs, then script:1394 -> require(old.totalStaked() == 0, "V1 still holds stake after migrate - widen the snapshot and re-run"); followed by script:1395 -> require(NFTStakerDepletionV2(v2).totalStaked() == v2Before + preTotal, "V2 total != pre-migration V1 total")
cases.result: HARD REVERT with a purpose-written, actionable message. A short list cannot pass. The conservation assert at :1395 is a second, independent check on the same fact.
cases.note: This is the guard that catches the DEFAULT_FROM_BLOCK=25000000 horizon risk in snapshot-depletion-stakers.js.

cases.case: FILE PRESENT but a staker KEY is missing/misspelled
cases.path: vm.parseJsonAddressArray at :1442 reverts on an unresolvable JSON path.
cases.result: HARD REVERT. Key names were verified to match (STAKER_KEYS in the JS == v2Key in Solidity).

cases.case: RESUME leg where st_<label>_migrate is already marked configured
cases.path: the whole `if (!_isConfigured(...))` block at :1389-1397 is skipped, so _loadSnapshotUsers is never called for that staker.
cases.result: No snapshot read at all - correct and intended. But it means a resume leg can complete without the snapshot file existing, which is only safe if the progress file was correctly hand-trimmed.
